en.title: Ikmal HR
en.text: Ikmal HR is a production-grade human resources platform for organizations in Saudi Arabia, built with Next.js. The Ikmal Smart Platform centralizes attendance and leave, payroll, performance management, and executive dashboards in one secure workspace. A dedicated Consultancy portal extends the product with expert-led HR advisory and operations—supported by bilingual (English/Arabic) access, role-based permissions, and analytics for HR teams and leadership.

en.title: SyncChat
en.text: SyncChat is a real-time 1:1 messaging app built with React, Express, MongoDB, and Socket.IO. It offers a modern chat UI with delivery and read receipts, typing indicators, and rich messaging—text, images, voice notes, replies, reactions, edits, and deletes. Users can pin, mute, archive, and block conversations; search across chats; and customize profiles with Cloudinary-backed photos. The product includes JWT and Google OAuth sign-in, link previews, light/dark themes, offline message queuing, optional notification sounds, and an admin panel for moderation—protected by Arcjet rate limiting on authentication routes.

en.title: ILM Give
en.text: ILM Give is a modern learning management platform for schools and educational institutes, built as a Next.js and Express monorepo with MongoDB. It unifies academics, assignments, grading, notifications, and role-based dashboards for admins, teachers, and students—alongside a public website with blog publishing, charity campaigns, and a Stripe-powered donation flow. Admins manage users, content, and contact submissions through a full CMS, while public routes ship with SEO metadata, sitemaps, and structured data for discoverability.
